title: “Learn at first concentration without effort’ transform work into play; make every yoke that you have accepted easy and every burden that you carry light! - this counsel, or command, or even warning, however you wish to take it, is most serious; this is attested by its original source, namely the words of the Master Himself: ‘My yoke is easy, and my burden is light’ (Matthew xi, 30).”
